ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
ayahs.meaning: Begin with Allah's name and mercy.

ayahs.translation: All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.meaning: Praise and gratitude belong to Allah.

ayahs.translation: The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Master of the Day of Judgment.
ayahs.meaning: Allah is in control of the final day.

ayahs.translation: You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help.
ayahs.meaning: We worship Allah and seek His help.

ayahs.translation: Guide us to the straight path.

ayahs.arabic: صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Sirata alladhina an'amta 'alayhim ghayri al-maghdubi 'alayhim wa la ad-dallin
ayahs.translation: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have angered You nor of those who go astray.
ayahs.meaning: Ask to stay on the path of the favored.
